executive_summary: Sven Olsen secretly smuggles a canary named Claribel onto an orbital space station. Claribel learns to fly in microgravity. One morning, Claribel is found unconscious due to a subtle oxygen drop caused by a frozen air purifier line. Claribel's collapse alerts the crew before electronic alarm sensors react, saving human lives.
